title: Testing Applications

header.html: Develop and validate tests with AWS SAM, AWS CDK and AWS CloudFormation (3.2.1); use mock APIs for external dependencies (3.2.2); create application test events (3.2.3); create and configure application environments (3.2.4); use AWS AI tools to generate tests and automate repetitive testing (3.2.5)
the official AWS Developer Associate (DVA-C03) exam guide, Task 3.2

html:
1Tests you write and run

Test What it checks
Unit test One function or module with no network; use mocks for AWS calls
Integration test Components working together (for example Lambda plus DynamoDB) in a test environment
End-to-end test A full flow through the deployed system
Regression test Old behavior still works after a change

AWS SAM, CDK and CloudFormation for testing

Tool Testing help
AWS SAM CLI sam local invoke runs a Lambda function locally in a container with a test event; sam local start-api runs an API locally
AWS CDK Define infrastructure in code, so you can unit-test the generated templates and create test stacks
AWS CloudFormation Validate templates; create disposable test stacks from the same template as production
Exam tip

. "Test a Lambda function on my laptop with an event" = SAM local invoke.

2Test events and mock dependencies

Technique Meaning
Test events JSON payloads that look like real events (an API Gateway request, an S3 notification, an SQS message) used to invoke a function (console test events, sam local invoke --event)
API Gateway test invoke Send a test request to a method without a client
Mock integration API Gateway returns a fixed response with no backend, so front-end teams can work before the backend exists
Mocks and stubs in code Replace AWS SDK calls in unit tests so tests are fast and free

3Environments

Mechanism How it separates environments
Lambda versions and aliases Alias dev, test, prod point to versions
API Gateway stages One API, several stages
Container image tags :dev, :prod or version tags in ECR
AWS Amplify branches A Git branch gets its own hosted environment
AWS Copilot environments Environments for containerized apps
Separate stacks or accounts Strongest isolation

4AI tools for testing

AWS AI tools can generate test cases, run tests automatically, analyze results, support regression testing and suggest coverage gaps [Verify live]. As with all AI output, the developer reviews generated tests: a test that always passes proves nothing.

Exam tip

. AI-generated tests are a starting point. Check that they assert real behavior and cover edge cases.

Exam tip

. Unit tests use mocks; integration tests use a real test environment. If the question says no network, it is a unit test.

5Exam Q&A

5.1 Practice questions (choose the best answer)

S1A developer wants to run a Lambda function locally with a sample S3 event before deploying. Which tool fits?

  • AAmazon Route 53
  • BAWS KMS
  • CAmazon EBS
  • DAWS SAM CLI sam local invoke
Show the answer

Answer: D. SAM local runs the function in a local container with a test event.

S2Front-end developers need an API to call before the backend exists. What can the back-end team set up in API Gateway?

  • AA dead-letter queue
  • BA mock integration
  • CA usage plan
  • DA VPC endpoint
Show the answer

Answer: B. A mock integration returns a fixed response with no backend.

S3A unit test of a function that writes to DynamoDB must not call AWS. What should the test use?

  • AA mock or stub of the SDK call
  • BThe production table
  • CA public bucket
  • DA larger timeout
Show the answer

Answer: A. Mocks keep unit tests fast, free and isolated.

S4A team wants dev, test and prod versions of one Lambda function. What should they use?

  • AVersions and aliases
  • BLayers
  • CEnvironment variables only
  • DDLQs
Show the answer

Answer: A. Aliases point to immutable versions for each environment.

S5What is the best description of a test event?

  • AA CloudWatch alarm
  • BA deployment strategy
  • CAn IAM policy
  • DA JSON payload shaped like a real event used to invoke a function
Show the answer

Answer: D. Test events imitate real triggers.

S6A team uses an AI tool that writes unit tests. What should the developer do?

  • ADelete all manual tests
  • BReview the tests for real assertions and edge cases
  • CSkip running them
  • DAssume full coverage
Show the answer

Answer: B. Generated tests need human review.

5.2 Recall questions

R1What does sam local invoke do?

Show the answer

Runs a Lambda function locally with a test event.

R2What is a mock integration?

Show the answer

An API Gateway method that returns a fixed response with no backend.

R3What is a Lambda alias?

Show the answer

A named pointer to a function version.

R4Name two environment mechanisms.

Show the answer

For example API Gateway stages and Lambda aliases.

R5What does a unit test avoid?

Show the answer

Network calls and real AWS resources, by using mocks.

R6Who checks AI-generated tests?

Show the answer

The developer.
